thread.gist: Booking confirmation received for AER-5C9X3T, LHR-GVA on 5 August. Thanks.
Thank you for booking with Aerlink. Your confirmation is attached.
Can I add a checked bag to this booking please?
Yes, a 23kg bag has been added. You'll see the charge on your card.
The charge has gone through twice. Can you look at that.
Apologies, one of those was an authorisation hold and will drop off in 3-5 days.
It has dropped off, thanks.
Summer fares to the Alps - book by 31 July. [newsletter]
Please stop sending me these.
Can I choose my seat in advance? I'd like an aisle.
Seat 14C has been allocated to you.
14C is fine. Thank you.
Advance notice: some services on 5 August may be affected by crew availability at LHR.
What does that notice mean for AK229 on Wednesday? Is it going or not?
AK229 is currently scheduled to operate. We will contact you if that changes.
AK229 LHR-GVA on 5 August has been cancelled. We are sorry for the disruption.
You have got to be joking. You told me yesterday it was operating.
CANCEL THE WHOLE BOOKING AND REFUND ME IN FULL. I do not want to be rebooked, I do not want a voucher, I want my money back and I will make my own arrangements.
We have received your request. A refund request has been queued for review.
Please DISREGARD the refund request below. My sister will drive me to the meeting; do NOT refund the booking. I still need to get back later in the month.
Understood. The refund request has been withdrawn and no refund will be issued. Your booking remains live.
Put me on the earliest Geneva flight you have on MONDAY 10 AUGUST. Same booking, same seat preference if possible. Please action the most recent one.
Forwarding entire thread because multiple agents asked for the same explanation; please read to the end and action the latest request.
